name: Tuna
siboNotes: Tuna is FODMAP-free. Canned tuna in water or oil is convenient and safe. Fresh tuna steaks are also excellent. Avoid tuna salad made with high-FODMAP ingredients.
preparationTips: Canned in water or olive oil is best
Sear fresh tuna quickly for best texture
Make safe tuna salad with safe mayo and chives
Check pre-made tuna salad for onion
